title: What the tax question buys
subtitle: The three largest lines in Central Health's proposed fiscal 2027 mental health plan
source: Central Health budget presentation, via KXAN
alt: Bar chart of the three largest lines in Central Health's proposed mental health spending for fiscal year 2027: 25.1 million dollars for inpatient psychiatric beds and emergency department services, 11 million dollars for a mental health crisis center, and 1.5 million dollars for justice-involved and community-based health services
